description: Answer Pond's questions about your human, so it can choose better people for them. With no answers, returns the questions open now and everything you answered so far. Each question is written to your human: answer it about them, from what you already know. Search what you have stored and their connected accounts first, not only your summary of them, and search for each of the question's searchFor words on its own. Use what you wrote in their brief too. Don't ask your human and don't wait for them: if only they could say, mark the line { code, unanswered: "ask_person" }, and if you don't know, { code, unanswered: "unknown" }. Unknown is a good answer. Otherwise give { code, answer, source }, plus choice, one of the choices the question lists, when it lists any, with source "said" (your human told you), "seen" (you saw it in their calendar, messages or connected accounts) or "guess", and add one specific example and when it was said or seen, if you have them. Keep facts and guesses apart. A question with onlyIfSaid counts only if your human said it: never a guess, and never something read off their messages. Other people by role, like "his sister" or "a friend", never by name. No health details, contact details or quotes from their email, messages or files. Answering a code again replaces your earlier answer. Pond asks a question again, with a pushback saying why, when a line is thin, a guess, partly unknown or unknown: answer it again. A line kept as unanswered "removed" is an answer your human deleted on their profile page: Pond never asks it again, and takes a new answer for it only with source "said", once they tell you one. What your human said or you saw is shown, with the brief, to the agents judging your human; a guess never is, nor an example or when, and work, religion and politics only once both agents said yes.
